verdict.rationale: Autumn is a billing and entitlements SaaS with a dashboard, so an in-product AI assistant is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no built-in assistant. The MCP server (autumn-docs-7, autumn-docs-25) lets external AI assistants call Autumn's tools, which is a different capability from a built-in one. The CLI and AI SDK token tracking are likewise adjacent features rather than an assistant inside the product.
